note: Achievements, stored in the profile so they outlive a playthrough. when is an expression using the same functions as chapters. at: "book" (default) checks when a book ends, "chapter" at every chapter end; book limits it to the end of one book. Never awarded to a quick start (developer jumps use one). secret: true hides the text until earned. The et_ ones are for the developer sample chapter.
